results.title: Code Isn't Memory: A Structural Codebase Index Inside a Coding Agent
results.summary: Empirically tests adding a structural codebase index to a coding-agent harness on SWE-PolyBench Verified and SWE-bench Pro, benchmarked against an agentic-grep baseline. Reports a large localization gain and a statistically separated resolve gain at a lower cost-per-solve than agentic grep.

results.title: SWE-Explore: Benchmarking How Coding Agents Explore Repositories
results.summary: Introduces a benchmark of 848 issues across 10 languages that isolates repository exploration, evaluating agents on coverage, ranking, and context-efficiency under a fixed line budget. Finds agentic explorers form a clear tier above classical retrieval and that line-level coverage and efficient ranking are the key differentiators.

results.title: FuseSearch: Learning Adaptive Parallel Execution for Efficient Code Localization
results.summary: Reframes parallel code localization as joint quality-efficiency optimization using only three read-only tools (grep, glob, read_file). Targets a 34.9% redundant invocation rate, achieving 67.7% fewer turns, 68.9% fewer tokens, and a 93.6% speedup on SWE-bench Verified.

results.title: LLM Agents Can See Code Repositories
results.summary: Empirical study of multimodal coding agents showing that supplementary visual repository graphs (folder hierarchies, dependency graphs) reduce input token consumption by up to 26% while maintaining or improving issue-resolution accuracy, vs. a vision-only setup which degrades accuracy.

results.title: Awesome-RL-based-Agentic-Search-Papers
results.summary: Curated list accompanying the survey 'A Comprehensive Survey on Reinforcement Learning-based Agentic Search' (arXiv:2510.16724). Organizes methods by RL functional role, including a Search Efficiency category with WWW 2026 papers on adaptive search decisions and retrieval-cost rewards.

results.title: Agentic Search: How Coding Agents Find the Right Code
results.summary: Practitioner analysis of coding-agent code search reporting that semantic search improves accuracy by about 12.5% over grep alone on large codebases, and identifies parallelism as the single most important search-layer optimization.

results.title: From grep to Moderne Trigrep: Faster, token-efficient code search for agents
results.summary: Benchmarks Moderne's Trigrep tool against standard agent grep/glob calls, reporting significant improvements in response time and token efficiency by replacing repeated lexical searches with structured, multi-criteria code search.
